s: My Summer Car is an open world survival game created by Finnish developer Johannes Rojola of Amistech. The game is set in rural Finland during the summer of 1995, where the 19-year-old player character has the family home to himself while his parents are on holiday in Tenerife. The player has to gather, recreate and improve their father's worn down Satsuma Amp using different car parts found all over the garage, as well as by buying new parts.
